title: UK production and supply of the Food Origins baskets (Defra, annual; national context)
coverage: United Kingdom; tomatoes, strawberries, potatoes, wheat (bananas: no Defra production series)
attribution: Source: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0

retrieval.method: Read offline from the committed Defra datasets (fetch-reference --set context)
retrieval.notes: Values as published (potato and wheat shares converted from fractions to per cent; wheat imports and exports are the sums of the EU and rest-of-the-world rows). Annual and national: never combined with HMRC monthly trade.
